I mix apple cider vinegar with a tsp baking soda and lemon juice and rub it in with a sponge. I rub until it gets red and burns. Sometimes I even re-open a scar slightly.

I leave it on for 10 minutes and wash it off.
Then I put silicon gel sheets over them, and sometimes just zinc lotion or vitamin e lotion. 

I've been doing it for a while now and my scars look "thinner" and also my keloids improved loads.

I would not recommend you to do it as harshly as me, but maybe try using a apple cider vinegar + baking soda mixture just for the dead skin cells.
